Greetings,

Northwind Retail is looking for a vendor to deliver an internal operations dashboard. Roughly 1,500 people will use it daily, the budget is about 60,000 USD, and the planned timeline is 4 months. Because we handle card data, PCI-DSS compliance is mandatory, including encryption and tokenization. The application should remain usable without internet access, buffering changes on the device until connectivity returns. We want a cross-platform mobile app that works on iPhones and Android devices and ships through the app stores. The core platform runs on a COBOL mainframe and an on-prem Oracle database, so experience with legacy technology is important.

Please send an indicative timeline together with the commercial proposal. We have a reference architecture document we can share after the first call.

Best regards,
David Chen
CTO, Northwind Retail

Dear team,

Lotus Travel is looking for a vendor to deliver a reporting and analytics tool. Roughly 5,000 people will use it daily, the budget is about 60,000 USD, and the planned timeline is 5 months. The platform must integrate with our existing CRM through its REST API, and the integration should handle rate limits gracefully. Single sign-on (SSO) against our internal IdP is a hard requirement. Single currency is fine; no multi-currency handling needed. We do not need native iOS or Android apps for this project. Offline mode is not required; users always have connectivity.

Please send an indicative timeline together with the commercial proposal. We are flexible on the technical stack as long as the solution is maintainable.

Best regards,
David Chen
CTO, Lotus Travel
